clips.title: The story
paras: Secure the Mountain is an Alliance quest originating in Kharanos, Dun Morogh. A local official compiling intelligence for Ironforge sends adventurers west of town to check on Mountaineer Gretchen after scouts investigating aggressive wendigos fail to report back.

Tasked with compiling local military intelligence for the high seat of Ironforge, an official in Kharanos finds his routine correspondence interrupted. A mountaineer team sent to assess nearby wendigo activity has failed to return with updates. Rather than spelunking through icy caverns himself, the bureaucrat enlists capable travelers to venture just west of town and determine the scouts' status.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge.
Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... Well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them.
If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!

clips.title: Completion
paras: I got his report, alright. This whole situation's a mess!
